_comment: Final 256 px cell coordinates, measured on the title-style art (Claude, 2026-10-11) from the packed frames (quantize 48): each hit box is the striking limb's contact end (wrist or ankle to the tips) plus 3 px, the packer's auto pad. Killua is the shortest fighter and most of his strikes stay inside his wide idle stance (front foot x 195), so the auto rule picks his hair (light2, light3, airLight2) or the whole front of the body (light1, heavy, airHeavy); these overrides replace them. Frames not listed keep the auto box, checked on the same art: light4 f3-f4 and airLight3 f2-f3 (the kicking shoe), airLight1 f1-f2 (the knife-hand), specialForward f2-f3 (the thrusting forearm and claw). The boxes follow the drawn limbs, so most sit lower and closer than the SPEC contact zones (tuned for the old ~218 px bodies). Re-checked 2026-10-12 (Claude QA agent, round 3) on the round-2 pack (idle v08, beamFire v09 at bodyHeight 123): the overrides still sit on their limbs; the auto boxes of light4 f3-f4, airLight1 f1-f2, airLight3 f2-f3 and specialForward f2-f3 start 3 px further forward (the idle v08 front edge is x 198, v05 x 195) with unchanged front edges and still cover the shoe / knife-hand / forearm and claw.

light3._refit: scaled x0.9506 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 180 -> 171 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

airLight2._refit: scaled x1.0256 about the pivot with the strip's bodyHeight 170 -> 174 (size consistency pass, 2026-10-11)

_hands: hand: palm point (256 cell) for shots and beams: the centroid of the drawn hand past the wrist, measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art from the packed frames. special f3 is the Narukami bolt's spawn frame (without a hand it spawned from the auto hit box on his head), throw f1 the air Narukami's; beamFire f0 is the beam / beam clash origin. beamFire re-measured 2026-10-12 (Claude QA agent, round 3) on v09 packed at bodyHeight 123: the centroid of the skin of both hands past the sleeve cuff; f1 is the recoil frame (palms 15 px behind f0/f2, the beam root stays at f0).
